```plato

    //==
    // Number
    //
    // A small set of shaping helpers that are deliberately Number-concrete rather
    // than generic over Real: they read the `Pow` intrinsic (declared only on
    // Number), and on a type that is simultaneously IMultiplicative and IScalable a
    // generic `x * 2.0` has two equally good readings. IVector/quantity versions
    // belong with the component-wise lifting on `IVector` (P3), not here.

    // x raised to the reciprocal power: the y-th root of x. InversePow(x, 2) is
    // the square root, InversePow(x, 3) the cube root. Precondition: y is not zero.
    InversePow(x: Number, y: Number): Number
        => x.Pow(1.0 / y);
```
